Chapter 929: Chapter 25: All Rules of the Great Dao Origin from Chaos (Please Subscribe)

Crack crack.

Following the appearance of the first crack.

On the surface of the immense ‘egg’, a second and third crack continuously appeared.

Each crack quickly spread, expanded, and split.

In an instant.

The mighty ‘egg’, spawned from myriad rules, was covered in cracks.

“Chaos!”

At this moment, Lin Yuan’s true body Primordial Spirit and all his avatars, finally completely merged all the rules they comprehended.

For a thousand years, Lin Yuan had comprehended more and more rules, and many of these rules had already begun to fuse, and now they completely merged together.

Boom!

The cracked mighty ‘egg’ silently collapsed, giving birth to a new rule overarching myriad rules, spawned from them.

This is Chaos.

Chaos Rule.

“Finally… I’ve finally comprehended the Chaos Rule.”

Lin Yuan opened his eyes, in the moment the Chaos Rule was born, Lin Yuan’s all avatars and both Primordial Spirits mastered it instantly.

“Is this the Chaos Rule?”

Everything in Lin Yuan’s view became simple.

If the Space-Time Rule is the foundation of all things and the movement of the world and the influence of rules cannot be separated from Space-Time Rule.

Then the Chaos Rule is everything of all things; from Space-Time Rule to the basic rules of metal, wood, water, fire, and earth, all stem from the Chaos Rule.

All Grand Dao rules originate from Chaos.

“My mind will, my soul, my body, everything about me, is getting stronger…” After giving birth to the Chaos Rule, Lin Yuan felt everything about him transforming dramatically.

In fact, it is very hard to advance further when one has reached the height like Lin Yuan; it’s nearly impossible to experience a surge in strength unless one crosses a major boundary.

A thousand years ago and a thousand years later, the latter Lin Yuan comprehended several million pillar-level fusion rules more than the former, but the strength difference between the two periods of Lin Yuan was not significant.

Several million pillar-level fusion rules, although numerous, seemed like loose soil.

Hard to form a unified power.

But now, as the Chaos Rule was born, several million rules on the other shore quickly combined, forming a razor-sharp, indestructible blade.

“Forty million points of mind will…” Lin Yuan slightly sensed and confirmed that his mind will had reached forty million points.

You should know, the enhancement of mind awareness is not like the enhancement of the physical soul; even immersed in the Origin Core of the Immortal Realm for a thousand years, Lin Yuan only managed to increase it by tens of thousands of points.

But now, just as the Chaos Rule was born, the mind will index has exceeded forty million points, and it hasn’t stopped yet, the mind will is still elevating.

“My perception of space and time is also rapidly improving.”

Lin Yuan’s gaze vaguely pierced through infinite space-time, where previously he could only sense the space-time range the size of a few dozen Immortal Realms.

Now this range is rapidly approaching the size of a hundred Immortal Realms, moving towards two hundred Immortal Realms, three hundred Immortal Realms.

“The world within the body…”

Lin Yuan looked at the world inside his own body, the true body’s internal world spanning two point three billion miles.

Not like the Main Universe which experienced a breakthrough from the tenth to the eleventh layer due to Chaos Void Origin Infusion; the normal size of the internal world is this range.

This is still based on the transformation enhancement caused by the mysterious gourd, otherwise the maximum limit would just be ten million square miles.

But at this moment.

With the birth of the Chaos Rule, the internal world also began to crazily expand—ten billion square miles, hundred billion square miles, a trillion square miles…

“Hm?”

“The River of Time?”

Lin Yuan looked towards the River of Time in the Immortal Realm.

Whether in the Main Universe or the Immortal Realm, Lin Yuan was always suppressed by the River of Time; to break free from this suppression, the only way is the ultimate leap, charging to the twelfth layer.

Even though the Martial Tao evolutionary path spread among infinite beings, the suppression from the River of Time on Lin Yuan was at most just slightly alleviated.

But now?

Lin Yuan clearly felt that the suppression from the River of Time on him had greatly decreased.

With the decrease in the suppression from the River of Time, when Lin Yuan makes the ultimate leap, the backlash he faces from the Time River would also decrease.

This is also why comprehending the Chaos Rule at the eleventh layer significantly increases the odds of successfully advancing to the ultimate twelfth layer.

Of course, this is just theoretical.

Those who have comprehended the Chaos Rule are no longer at the eleventh layer.

The so-called comprehending Chaos Rule at the eleventh layer is merely based on the principle that chaos derives everything.

In essence, the Time River stems from the combination of time and space; space-time can suppress all life but cannot suppress Chaos.

As long as one comprehends the Chaos Rule, even if it’s just the First Realm of the Chaos Rule, it can greatly negate the suppression and backlash of the Time River.

“Chaos Rule is the threshold for the Dominion Realm to step into the Chaos Realm, to become a powerful entity in the Chaos Realm, one must comprehend the Chaos Rule.”

Lin Yuan silently thought to himself.

The twelfth layer is divided into three levels: Dao Initiation, Dominion, and Chaos.

Twelfth-layer Chaos Realm could traverse the Chaos Void; entities like Xuanhuang are peak forces in the Chaos Realm.

Of course, Xuanhuang and the Moyu Tower Master are such.

“With my current strength, should I be able to confront beings like the Ancestor of the Immortal Realm head-on?” Lin Yuan secretly thought.

Before comprehending the Chaos Rule, aided by the Space-Time Seventh Realm, Lin Yuan could only manage to survive in front of the Ancestor of the Immortal Path.

Given the twelfth-layer ultimate foundation of the Ancestor of the Immortal Path, even standing still and letting Lin Yuan attack, it would probably be hard to break through his defense.
